sites.source: ReserveMN grid + details, facility 755 Lower Campground: 15 web-bookable Drive-In units (#40-45, #51-60; posted lengths 30-125 ft, #53 Pull-thru) and 3 Cart-In units (#46-48); DNR 'RV Length Limit 60 Feet' park-wide, read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: MN DNR Temperance River overnight facilities ('Electric Sites: 18 Sites. All electric sites are in the upper campground.') + ReserveMN facility 755 has only Drive-In and Cart-In unit types, read 2026-11-11

values.note: Showers and flush toilets are in the upper campground (seasonal); vault toilets year-round around the park. No dump station and limited water in the park.

facilities.source: MN DNR Temperance River overnight facilities ('Accessible showers are available in the upper campground.'; 'Accessible flush toilets are available in the upper campground.'; 'Vault toilets are located throughout the park.') + seasonal update ('The park does not have a dump station. Please fill your RV water before arriving at the park.'; 'There is limited water and no dump station.'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: $24 a night for a drive-in site (no electric in this campground). ReserveMN's prices for June 2027 nights.

fees.source: ReserveMN search/details for every unit of facility 755, 2027-06-15 ('Rate 24.00' on all 18), read 2026-11-11

note: Drive-in campground on the Lake Superior side of Hwy 61 at the Temperance River mouth, with a canoe access to the lake; the DNR says some sites have an excellent lake view. Sites 53 and 55 are on a steep grade the DNR recommends only for tents or very small trailers. Fill with water before arriving. --Claude
summary: DNR page + every ReserveMN unit read: Lower Campground is 15 drive-in (30-125 ft, one pull-through) + 3 cart-in sites, no electric, $24 re-confirmed; showers/flush toilets are in the upper campground, vault toilets in the park, no dump station (dump false added). Site count 34 -> 15. Lakeview kept; coastal walk also arguable.
flags: Waterfront: keep lakeview (DNR: 'Some sites in the lower campground have an excellent view of the lake.'). Not lakefront: on leaf-off imagery the nearest drive-in units, #41 (47.55291,-90.87450), #42 (47.55282,-90.87460) and #44 (47.55264,-90.87469), are about 50-60 m from the water at the river-mouth beach, and #45/#53/#55 about 85-90 m, with sparse trees and the beach between; MapInfo points are not precise enough to call any of them within 50 m over open ground. The campground is on the lake side of Hwy 61 with only park roads and the beach between it and Lake Superior, so `coastal walk` would also fit; reviewer's choice between the two.

Access: DNR 'Campsites #53 and #55 have a steep grade, which many campers are finding to be inaccessible with their camping trailers and RVs. We recommend only tent campers or extremely small trailers use these two sites.' Two sites only, written into the note as a caveat; the other 13 drive-in units are unaffected.
Fit: every Lower drive-in unit posts 30 ft or more (#51 30 ft, the rest 39-125 ft); stored max_rig_ft 60 is the DNR park-wide limit and was left.

Pin 47.55392,-90.87484 is ~130 m north of the Lower Campground unit centroid (47.55275,-90.87512): OK. The Upper Campground (centroid 47.55515,-90.87116, about 450 m NE, east of the river) is the park's other campground with all 18 electric sites; it is not in the DB as its own entry (lead for the reviewer, not a split I can make).

Phone: none stored; the park's number is 218-663-3100 (DNR contact). apply.py does not write phones. Website: suggest adding https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state_parks/park.html?id=spk00268 beside the ReserveMN link.

Season: none stored and not written. DNR seasonal update (November 2026): 'The campground is OPEN for the season' with water, flush toilets and showers off; ReserveMN shows Lower Campground units free but flagged out of season through the 120-day window. Reviewer may want a year-round season with a winter note.
Policy row: DNR seasonal update says 'Reservations are strongly recommended from May to mid-October', softer than the state:MN reservation-only rule; every Lower unit is AllowWebBooking true.
